description: Smart-search filters for the Utilization tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. This tab intentionally has NO chips. unitType was dropped by request; lineStatus is excluded because it filters the numerator only, which yields a misleading utilisation ratio; and fromDate/toDate/days are the REQUIRED window, supplied by the page-level Period control (preset + Custom range) rather than by search — reportCriterion maps no date params for this endpoint for exactly that reason. Free-text q still works on yard name and code.
